validity_notes: The positive control and null control are mathematically degenerate when |R|=1 (all states share 1 hash). The permutation null has zero variance because permuting identical labels produces identical data. The pass criterion (|BC PMI| < 3*std AND std > 0) requires std > 0, which is impossible when the response variable is constant. This is NOT a validity failure — it is the expected mathematical behavior of the estimator under the fully-ambiguous condition. The preregistered positive control was designed for the many-to-one condition (2 hashes) where perm_std > 0.

The frozen decision rule's C2 clause (BC PMI > 0.05 with Bonf p < 0.0125) triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING. The C3 clause (positive control pass) also fails due to degeneracy, but this is redundant with C2 failure. The scientific answer (BC PMI = 0.0) is unambiguous regardless of control validity.

The experiment was executed correctly: FSM parameters match parent (seed=42, p_left=0.7, p_right=0.3, 200 trajectories × 10 steps = 2000 transitions), session directions identical to parent, content mapping is fully-ambiguous (1 unique hash confirmed).
No infrastructure failure occurred. The result is a valid scientific negative: BC PMI = 0.0 exactly when response content carries zero state-identifying information.

The Bonferroni correction uses 2 comparisons (1 condition × 2 K values), but the preregistered threshold of 0.0125 (α/4) is used for comparability with the parent. This is conservative but does not affect the conclusion since p_bonf = 1.0.

The degenerate positive/null controls at |R|=1 mean the pipeline cannot be independently validated under the fully-ambiguous condition. The pipeline was validated under the parent's many-to-one condition where perm_std > 0. No new pipeline validation is provided by this experiment.

The claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS regarding genuine predictive dynamics beyond partial state discrimination on locally-hosted synthetic FSM is not supported by this experiment. The PMI vanishes entirely when partial discrimination is eliminated.
